It will take a variety of different tasks to get each fish to the reef, including, but not limited to, rolling plastic baggies across busy roads, escaping the clutches of an octopus, swimming away from a deadly angler fish, riding the East Australian Current, and more! Each game is played either with the stylus, or a combination of the stylus and the DS' microphone.

In addition to this, there is also an 'Interactive Reef' feature that allows players to create their own customisable environment for the escaped fish to live in, choosing from either the ocean or an aquarium. It is possible to earn more items for your Reef by scoring well in the mini-games, which convert the points into tokens for you to spend.

There are also three two player multiplayer games that can be played via multi-card multiplayer: Octo-Bash, Hide and Seek, and Pearl Blast. These games are two-player versions of games that you play in the single-player mode

179139.overview: Fairy Tail Gekitotsu! Kardia Daiseidou is a video game of Fairy Tail for Nintendo DS. It is the second game created on the Nintendo DS, developed by Hudson and it follows the story of the Battle of Fairy Tail arc to the Oración Seis arc.

179148.overview:
Sora no Otoshimono Forte: Dreamy Season is a Japan-exclusive Visual novel/Adventure game, developed and published by Kadokawa Shoten for the Nintendo DS, based on the anime Sora no Otoshimono Forte, the second season of Sora no Otoshimono.

The game mostly consists of typical visual novel/dating simulator gameplay in which the main character, Tomoki, visits and talks to his friends, and you decide which dialogue option to choose next in order to further various game options. Once in a while, you get to pleasure one of the girls, where you use the DS Stylus Pen to tap and rub on different body parts. The longer it takes, the lower your achieved score.

The game's RPG/dating sim-esque elements include various RPG elements, such as earning money and upgrading your character's stats. Money is earned through the various pleasuring-games encountered. Money is spent on sorts of training activities.

181394.overview: Fresh PreCure! Asobi Collection is an Action game, developed by Suzak and published by Bandai Namco Games, which was released in Japan in 2009.

181467.overview: Fruits Mura no Doubutsu Tachi 2 is an Action game, developed and published by TDK Core, which was released in Japan in 2006.

181486.overview:
Climb the Tower of Fortune and Challenge Reeva, the God of Destiny!

After stopping the revival of a demon god at the Magic Castle of the Desert, Shiren and Koppa set off in search of new adventures. Soon thereafter, our heroes wandered into small village. This village, Inori, has a legend that claims, If you climb the Tower of Fortune that soars above the enchanted land and face Reeva, the god of Destiny, you can change your fate. Shiren and Koppa, having confirmed many mysterious legends throughout their journeys, decide to embrace this new challenge.

Is there really an entity determining peoples fates? And is it possible for a person to change their fate? What adventures await Shiren and his friends in the tower?

181489.overview: Ootori Madoka falls into the hands of The Universe of the Four Gods along with her friend Himuro Masaki, same as how Miaka and Yui entered. While Masaki goes missing, Madoka is fortunate enough and ends up in the emperor's palace, safe. The story of the series continues allthroughout, following the milestones unless the player chooses different options. Depending of the player choices, some characters who didn't survive in the original series can be saved.

184192.overview: Kurukuru * Princess: Tokimeki Figure * Mezase! Vancouver is a Sports game, developed and published by Spike, which was released in Japan in 2009.

191118.overview: Fuyu no Sonata DS is an adventure game, developed and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2009.

191243.overview: Fujimori Midori no Let's Tarot is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by ASNetworks, which was released in Japan in 2007.

191350.overview: The Frogman Show DS: Datte, Shouganai janai. is a Japanese action game released for the Nintendo DS. It is based on the flash animation series The Frogman Show, which features popular segments like Eagle Talon (Himitsu Kessha Taka no Tsume).

191357.overview: Fuuun! Dairoujou is a Strategy game, developed and published by Kawamoto Sangou, which was released in Japan in 2009.

191439.overview: FabStyle is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Koei Tecmo Games, which was released in Japan in 2011.

191441.overview:
In Fukoumori: Molily no Unhappy Project, players follow Molily, a princess from the land of misfortune. Molily, along with her misfortune bats, helps characters in her village overcome bad luck. The narrative unfolds as Molily interacts with the villagers and discovers the causes of their misfortunes.

The game features diagnostic tests and mini-games that players use to identify and dispel misfortune. Activities such as fortune-telling, room decoration, and other mini-games provide a mix of gameplay styles aimed at turning misfortune into happiness.

191442.overview: Fushigi? Kagaku: Nazotoki Quiz Training - NazoTore is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Good-Feel and published by Benesse, which was released in Japan in 2008.

191443.overview:
"Futari wa PreCure Max Heart: Danzen! DS de PreCure: Chikara o Awasete Dai-battle!!" is a beat 'em up  inspired by the anime series "Pretty Cure Max Heart." Players control Pretty Cure characters, battling enemies and using special abilities to progress through the game's storyline, which closely follows the anime.

The gameplay involves single-player mode where players can perform combos and special moves. The game also includes various mini-games and additional modes to provide variety in the playing experience.

191444.overview: Futari wa PreCure Splash Star: Panpaka Game de Zekkouchou! is a Beat 'em up based on the "Pretty Cure Splash Star" anime series. Players control characters from the show, navigating through various challenges and battles. The game's storyline follows the anime, with players completing missions and fighting enemies using character-specific abilities.

192225.overview: The flunkers on the moon are full of speed and excitement and that's something the flunkers love! Aliens from all over the universe have taken to the moon to participate in the intergalactic moon race. But there is a bit of an owl in the moon bog, because all the while the moon race is in full swing, someone is in the process of destroying the moon. And of course the flunkies are mischievous and cheeky, but they won't be involved in destroying the moon! Help President Lobl find the culprits and put an end to the destruction.

192226.overview: Flunkerne Superskurke is an Action game, developed and published by Krea Media, which was released in Europe in 2009.

192227.overview: Fort Boyard returns to Nintendo DS in a new opus, specifically oriented towards the world of puzzles and enigmas. This episode with exclusive content complements the other titles of the TV show. You will find 12 infernal puzzles, 6 degis and 40 riddles posed by Father Fouras and the masters of Darkness...

192228.overview: Fort Boyard the famous TV show is now on NDS! Will you be able to challenge the 19 games to win the famous Boyard coins? The game features an adaptable level of difficulty and high-score saving for replayability.

192229.overview: With buddy BUDDY in your pocket, you can improve your French anytime, anywhere. BUDDY accompanies you through the thick and thin of learning French - with a guarantee of motivation and lots of fun. LOOK AND FEEL - INGENIOUS The unique look of BUDDY's own world not only has a high recognition value. It is motivating, colourful, fun and sporty - just brilliant. VOCABULARY - TOTAL With the thematically sorted vocabulary, the next visit to France will be child's play. In over 1,000 vocabulary games, the extensive vocabulary is taught to you in a lively way, sorted by topic. Of course, typical idioms and paraphrases should not be missing here either. Everything can be found quickly and clearly in the extensive dictionary section. GRAMMAR - GREAT In over 1,000 varied grammar exercises you will be taught everything you need to know about adjectives, adverbs, plural formation, pronouns, sentence order or tenses. So that you don't lose track, the entire grammar section is divided into different subject areas and lessons. FEATURES Successor to the successful award winner and top seller English Buddy Vocabulary with over 1,000 vocabulary games, divided into subject areas Practical dictionary with numerous typical idioms Extensive dictation section, spoken by native speakers

192239.overview: Reader Rabbit: On a Mission to Help the Lion Flowers is a video game released on the Nintendo DS in 2011 developed by The Learning Company and published by Nordic Softsales and Prelusion Games. It was released exclusively in Europe in the English, French, Finnish, Swedish and Norwegian languages. The game is essentially a partial version of Reader Rabbit Learn to Read With Phonics: 1st & 2nd Grade.

192894.overview: The Celestini are the reigning champions, but the qualification for the next world championships is still in the balance, especially after the departure of the Finezza twins. Fortunately, two new players have taken their place, their names are Jeremy and Samira. If they want to defend the title, the Celestines will have to start training again and show everyone that solidarity, friendship and respect are the foundations of Street Football. Take part in the adventures of the second season, with 7 new minigames and 2 new characters. As in the television series, each character has their own particular playing techniques. Travel the world and face opponents of all nationalities.

209482.overview: The hero of the game is a courageous young boy. You must lead him through various worlds full of obstacles to retrieve his stolen goldfish called Flipper! Get ready for a 3D puzzle platform game set over 4 different worlds, with 5 levels each! The game features beautiful pixel-art backdrops, cheerful cartoon characters and catchy music. The voxel engine technology allows you to change the environment with some cool power-ups. You can find power-ups that let you blast holes in the environment, build platforms, or restore parts you've previously destroyed. It's up to you to use the limited amount of power-ups wisely to complete each level. Flipper is a fun and challenging puzzle game that is suitable for all ages.

209493.overview:
This is a full-on action RPG, packed with breathtaking challenges, that takes place inside a neverending dungeon.

Get ready to face the monsters crawling about the various dungeons, and try your hand at defeating the terrifying boss monster lurking in the darkest depths.

Using the attack known as "Soul Capture", the main character can steal monsters' magic and other skills, as well as pick up weapons and shields to power up along the way...

You'll get an exhilarating rush from strengthening the character through combinations of different equipment and skills, before crushing the monsters with a powerful sweep of your weapon.

209614.overview: Furries are cute beings that enjoy rolling around in the sun all day long. But stone-cold Squaries - hating everything that is round and fluffy - attack! Now it is up to you to create chain reactions that will pop the invaders. Prove your skill in four different game modes: CLASSIC, CHALLENGE, TIME TRIAL and ENDLESS. Use the Squaries' special abilities like gravity, air blast and split to plan your blasts for maximum efficiency!

209615.overview: Furry Legends is a fantasy adventure game based on the same WiiWare game. The environment and puzzles in Furry Legends are driven by real-time physics, featuring moving bridges, falling stones, rotating elevators, and much more. In the Furry Legends world, everything is a bit crazy!

209861.overview: Soar through the sky, from the comfort of your sofa, with the innovative gliding game Face Pilot! Face Pilot not only puts your face into the game with the Nintendo DSi camera, it also tracks your head's movements giving you complete control of your glider. Simply tilt your head sideways to steer left and right, back to climb, and forwards to dive. There are three different types of gameplay: burst all the balloons to reach the goal, throw balls at targets for a high score, and try for a fast time in the high speed challenge. Also, look out for hidden medals which help unlock new courses and even new gliders! Face Pilot is a truly unique game that wouldn't be possible without Nintendo DSi. The only thing missing is the wind in your hair!

209895.overview: Join the elite circle of Ferrari car owners and take part in exclusive races around the globe. Choose from 32 car models including the Ferrari California, F430, Enzo Ferrari, Testarossa and 250 GTO, and experience each model's unique driving sensation. Streak across seven cities and one circuit in a racing simulation that tests your speed and control. Take on challenges from other Ferrari drivers or play against your friends in multiplayer mode, plotting your own course to the finish line to win.

209896.overview: Jiang is one of the best ferrymen in the world and transports everything across the river. Master Fu has offered him a large sum of money to transport all his wares to the other side of the river. This is a puzzling problem, since there are wolves and sheep amongst his goods - and the wolves love to eat sheep. Can you help Jiang to get everything across safely?

209898.overview: Descend into the world of Fieldrunners, one of the most anticipated and visually stunning games in handheld tower defence history! Defend and control the field using a diverse selection of upgradeable towers, a wide array of tactics and strategies against countless waves of unique land and air combatants! Enjoy hours of entertainment and replayable challenges! Do you have what it takes to dominate the Fieldrunners and rise to the top as the ultimate tower defence master?

209899.overview: Burn rubber with Fire Panic! As a futuristic firefighter in Fire Panic, you are facing the continuous challenge of extinguishing more and more fires that keep flaring up. To do this, use your stylus and mark the fastest route for your fire engine to get to each blaze. The engine will follow the line you drew and automatically douse each fire it passes along the way. A thrilling experience every time you play!

209900.overview:
Keep the skies safe on your Nintendo DSi with the insanely addictive Nintendo DSiWare download Flight Control!

In this action-packed game, you will take on the role of an air traffic controller at an increasingly busy airport. In complete control of the airspace, you must direct aircraft to their appropriate landing zones while avoiding collisions. You'll travel to airports set among green fields, a beachside resort, the Australian Outback, a winter wonderland and even an aircraft carrier. Learn how to land ten different kinds of aircraft, including jets, seaplanes and helicopters.

To direct aircraft, simply touch and drag them to their landing zones with the stylus without letting them collide. Sounds easy? As planes begin to arrive thick and fast, you'll need smart strategy, keen eyes and a smooth touch to keep the chaos under control! You can even work alongside a friend in cooperative multiplayer mode, and guard the airways together.

Thanks to an in-game tutorial, Flight Control only takes a minute to learn - just don't expect to put it down as quickly as you'll pick it up!

209901.overview:
Before the Big Bang shaped the universe as we know it, a place existed with fewer dimensions than we have today. It is there that our hero's journey began, and he carried with him a special device that allowed him to flip between these flat dimensions...

Flip the Core is an artistic and unique take on the classic shoot 'em up genre and combines fast shooting action with strategic thinking. In this side-scrolling action game, you can literally flip your screen at will, changing walls into tunnels, a death trap into a passageway and moving an enemy from one spot to the next. Unless you truly believe in dead ends...there are none.

209902.overview: Your face, your game, you’re the hero! In Foto Face: The Face Stealer Strikes YOU get to be in the game! Using the camera and microphone, you become the hero in your own game! Unlock a variety of hero costumes as you battle the baddies, search for stars, and solve platforming puzzles. The Face Stealer has stolen your identity and is creating trouble—and everyone is blaming you. You have to track him down across 15 action-packed stages. Along the way, you’ll come across many memorable creatures, both friend and foe. Use the camera and microphone to create faces and voices for every character in your game. Foto Face: The Face Stealer Strikes—a game starring YOU!

209903.overview: Frenzic is a unique puzzle game that dazzles the eye, teases the brain and keeps you coming back for more! It takes only minutes to learn, but months to master as you devise new, impressive play strategies to push your brain to its limit. Compete against your personal best and climb through six levels of Devotion, from Newbie all the way to Frenzic Master. Frenzic is a 'must have' for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages!

209917.overview:
GO Series presents Fishing Resort from Mechanic Arms.

Feel the swing of the fishing rod as you cast, the tension in the line as you reel in the fish and its weight as you catch it with the net. Use the stylus to feel every bite, tug and pull. Buy new rods, lines, floats and bait, take part in challenges and trade Member's Cards and Rankings with friends via wireless communications. Developed in Japan with anime graphics and style, Fishing Resort oozes charm and is a delight to play.

210156.overview: Blaze a path across the galaxy in this unique puzzle game. Holding the Nintendo DSi vertically, you must plot a route for your Flametail pod, using its red hot exhaust trail to burn through obstacles on your way to the next planet. Manoeuvre around a maze of blocks to burn them away as your pod passes by to clear the stage. Fortunately, there are plentiful power-ups and items such as the Bomb to blast a wide radius, or Radar which grants you a map to aid your route. In the main Space Tour mode, journey from Earth into outer space on a block-burning and brain-busting voyage. Or set yourself a challenge against the clock in Time Limit mode. Plus – if you achieve a high score, you can even take a photo of yourself with the inner camera of the Nintendo DSi system and show off your winning smile!

210158.overview:
Many untouched caverns still exist in the world, waiting for someone brave enough to explore them. Within them lie vast troves of treasure and rare artefacts.

Become Tyrol the treasure hunter, collect treasures and escape from the caverns. Be warned though – there are creatures lurking in the depths of the caverns, and nature is against you. Use your pickaxe wisely or you'll find yourself trapped and lost forever within the darkness of the caverns.

Can Tyrol collect enough treasure in order to win the heart of the woman he loves?

213043.overview:
Der Fluch der Osterinsel is a graphic adventure game and the sequel to Galileo Mystery: Die Krone der Midas.

In the game the player takes on the role of Stephan and his Ex-girlfriend Jessica. Together they search for a relic named the legendary 26th Rongorongo panel. The journey leads Stephan and Jessica from St. Petersburg to Mumbai, Lima and the Easter Islands. But they have to hurry, because some villains are also on the hunt for the relic to solve the riddle of the mysterious Rongorongo panel.

The Wii version uses 3D scenes in which the characters move around where the DS version uses drawn 2D backgrounds, but gameplay is identical.

213045.overview: Flunkene Pirater is an Action game, developed and published by Krea Media, which was released in Europe in 2009.

213046.overview:
How do memory geniuses memorize entire phone book pages? And you can't even get your partner's phone number right away? It's all very simple: it's based on science and an easy-to-learn system.

Martin Simon, recognized expert in memory training, gets your memory and memory skills up to speed in an entertaining way in 12 basic exercises with 60 training units.

Experience the art of memorization and amaze yourself and others with your skills.

213048.overview:
The ideal preparation for the theoretical driving test. With 60 up-to-date test papers for each driver's license class and the test point evaluation to fill out. Including exam mode with built-in countdown function for the realistic theory exam under time pressure. Special learning aids such as asking for wrong answers again or the extensive bonus material, fine and point calculator, varied mini-games and an extensive statistical function round off the package.

We offer the user a free choice of learning topics (traffic signs, vehicle technology, etc.). Thus, the user can decide for himself at any time how long and how much he wants to learn. He also has the option of simulating the theoretical test at any time. In order to increase motivation, the mini-games are only activated after a certain number of correctly answered questions or tests. In this way, the user remains motivated and gets the necessary break between the learning sections through the games.

Features:
* Driving license categories: AA, A1, B, S, M and moped
* 60 current test papers for each driver's license class
* Status of the examination papers: February 2008
* The test mode corresponds to the theoretical driving test
* Countdown function of the exam simulation under time pressure
* Incl. fine and points calculator
* Including blood alcohol calculator
* 4 mini-games, which are unlocked after successful learning
* Clear statistics function
* 4 profiles for different driving license classes (freely selectable)
* Stick and keyboard controls.

216374.overview:
Hop your way to the safety of your home.

Frogger Returns is a 2D platform game with 3D graphics. It plays much like the classic Frogger but now there are power-ups to gather that stop time, reverse the traffic, or make you invulnerable to road or water hazards, etc. There are up to four levels of play set in the city, subway, sewers, and swamp.

219712.overview:
The magical world of Lillifee is now reaching children on Nintendo DS. Lillifee's fairy magic uses the possibilities of the Nintendo DS to suit the target group: games on both screens, simple navigation with the stylus and simple voice input will delight Lillifee fans big and small.

Come to Princess Lillifee's Castle Garden! A beautiful, enchanting world awaits you, full of magic, fun and funny games! Make up and decorate the little princess, choose music and dance steps, try on hats, shoes and dresses...

The children can:
• Make Lillifee dance
• Dress up Lillifee
• Make up Lillifee
• Paint with Lillifee
• Breed butterflies with Lillifee
• Play lots of little mini-games like find pearls, find pairs and others.

Thanks to the consistent voice output, Princess Lillifee: Fairy Magic is also ideal for non-readers.

425628.overview:
It's a real action RPG with preeminent exhilaration set inside an infinitely-extending dungeon.

Sweep away the monsters wriggling in many places and get at defeating a strong boss monster lurking at the deepest portion of the dungeon.

Even after the boss monster is defeated, the dungeon re-creates itself with automatic system so the player can try new games over and over.

Using the skill called "Soul Capture," the mail character can take away the magic and other skills from the monsters, as well as weapons and shields to power up.

It is very exhilarating to strengthen the character combining the equipments and skills, then crushing the monsters in a sweep.

The player can enjoy a simple and yet profound world of From The Abyss, " Anonymous Notes."

The items, skills, and the magic collected in Chapter 2 can be shared between other titles of this series.

425629.overview:
Play serious! A true action RPG! Defeat all the flock of monster looming!

It's a real action RPG with preeminent exhilaration set inside an infinitely-extending dungeon. Sweep away the monsters wriggling in many places and get at defeating a strong boss monster lurking at the deepest portion of the dungeon. Even after the boss monster is defeated, the dungeon re-creates itself with automatic system so the player can try new games over and over. 460108.overview:
This is a merged patch of several previous mods for Shadow Dragon - it combines the Prologue in Hard Mode, Updated Gaiden Requirements Removal, Online Shop Items Integrated into Normal Gameplay, and Always Recruit Norne patches into one. This allows the player to recruit all units, experience all chapters, access all classes, and use the game’s full inventory without content being locked behind death requirements, difficulty level, or the now-defunct Online Shop.

As an added bonus, this patch also comes with a variant that updates certain unit graphics and battle background graphics to their FE12 versions; comparison screenshots can be found on the download page. In general, the FE12 graphics use a slightly brighter color palette and make the black outline around units less noticeable.

Finally, this mod includes a version which includes Arch’s Sync Patch. This patch updates growth rates, class stats, and weapons to use their FE12 stats; however, it makes the game considerably easier than intended, as the FE12 statistics for these things were balanced for an entirely different game. Still, the option is provided here for those who would prefer it. Note that the Sync Patch includes the FE12 graphical update.

Reduce your weight based on the new Fit For Fun diet from Dörte Wilke.

Includes 60 lessons on nutrition including nutrition quiz to test their knowledge.
The lessons completed always unlock new quiz questions.
Good control of the weight progression with determination of the BMI and a clear gradient curve with starting weight and target weight.
